cap: Each bar spans the steps a method can block. Combined hormones and emergency pills act before ovulation, levonorgestrel only until the LH surge starts and ulipristal a little later, while the copper IUD stops fertilization. Nothing left of the dashed line can end a pregnancy that has implanted, which is why emergency contraception is not an abortifacient. Mifepristone and then misoprostol act only after implantation, to detach and expel the pregnancy.
